Third alpha. Crowd control and toughness/stagger — previously built in code but not wired into the game (see v0.2.0-alpha's "Known limitations") — are now live in combat, and the effect system that will eventually express most anime/book/film-style abilities took a big step forward.

## Play
Download the archive for your OS, unpack, run `ai-evolve` (`ai-evolve.exe` on Windows). The hero is AI-controlled; you are the level director:

- **1 / 2 / 3** — spawn an enemy / trap / chest next to the hero
- **Space / left mouse** — force an attack
- **Esc** — quit

The standalone build starts on the small dev map; run with `--full` for the full-size world. Logs are written to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\AI-EVOLVE\output.log` (Windows) or the equivalent user data folder.

## What's new since v0.2.0-alpha
- **Crowd control is live**: a handful of boss abilities now really stun, blind, root or slow the hero — this used to exist as an unused mechanism, it now actually lands in combat.
- **Toughness/stagger is live**: every landed hit now chips away at a poise-style toughness bar (base values by class: player 100, regular enemy 800, boss 2000, elite 1500 — the original numbers). Break it and the target is stunned for 5 s, takes 15% more damage while broken, and its toughness bar grows a little (capped) so repeated breaks don't trivialize a fight. The elemental effectiveness matrix (fire vs ice, etc.) is intentionally left neutral for now — porting the old 15-element matrix onto the current 7 damage types is a balance decision, not a mechanical one, and needs a real design pass before it ships with numbers.
- Combo reactions: freeze+burn (melt), freeze+shock (superconduct), burn+poison (explosion, area), and stacking bleed/shock past their cap (hemorrhage/overload) now deal real bonus damage when content uses two statuses together.
- The effect system's blind holdout benchmark (60 unseen abilities, tagged from the design spec alone) moved from 36.7% to 60.0% expressible — generic preconditions/costs on any ability, a reaction/interrupt window, cone/sphere target areas, and a long tail of one-off abilities ported by composing ops that already existed, no new mechanism needed for most of them.
- Renamed the long-running `dev_probe` dev tool to `scry` (same tool, `tools/scry.py` / `tools/scry_diff.py`).

## Developer & QA tooling
- `qa.py ctxwatch` — watches the enabled account plugins/skills for context-bloat creep across sessions.
- `qa.py check --name standing_context` — flags it if `CLAUDE.md`/the agent-context docs grow past a size ceiling (paid on every agent spawn).
- `qa.py bisect` — did a working-tree diff actually cause an observed gameplay difference, and which file: automates the git-worktree-plus-trace-compare forensics that used to be done by hand.

## Fixed with the help of the new tools
- The toughness class fallback (used to size an entity's toughness bar when no explicit value is set) was silently reading an attribute the real hero/enemy objects never set, so the player would have been misclassified into the 800-toughness "enemy" tier instead of the intended 100. Fixed at the source (`EntityState.faction`) rather than papering over it with more data.
- A new `status`-application op collided with an existing Lua alias name and would have silently done nothing when wired into live content; caught before it shipped and renamed (`apply_status`).

## Known limitations
- The toughness elemental-effectiveness matrix is neutral (no type is resisted or extra-effective yet) — tracked as a follow-up once the balance numbers are decided.
- HUD does not show toughness, inventory, or skills/cooldowns yet; stats display is still just HP/mana/stamina plus level/XP.
- The hero has no ranged-weapon fallback when melee can't reach (enemies already do); no physical/movement ability learning (rolls, jumps, sprints) yet; world population (biome bosses, periodic mob waves) not implemented yet.
- Same platform note as v0.2.0-alpha: gameplay golden scenarios were recorded on Linux, so a Windows dev run shows expected (not bug) differences; CI is the source of truth.
